newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 opens slightly weaker.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 opens slightly weaker.

text.p: UK's benchmark FTSE 100 opened slightly weaker on Thursday ahead of what was expected to be a day of consolidation, dealers said.
At 0749 GMT, the leading share index was 8.7 points lower at 4,716.1.
June FTSE 100 futures were down 7.0 points to 4,733.0. Dealers said the premium on futures should help steady the spot market.
They said they expected the market to hold within narrow ranges this morning after the recent rally to record levels, plotting technical support at 4,700 and resistance at 4,740.
